protocol.name: MMMU-Pro local direct evaluation v1
protocol.instruction: Choose the correct option. Respond with only one line: Answer: X, replacing X with its option letter.
protocol.standard_images: Each referenced image is shown once with a Figure label. Question and option references use the same labels.
protocol.vision_input: Screenshot and shared instruction only. Option text and gold answers are never included separately in the model input.
protocol.grading: Uniform audited letter parser: last explicit Answer line, or a response-leading valid letter with optional option text. No search for arbitrary letters in free explanation, no random fallback and no retry. Same parser for all five models; saved base/R20 outputs are reparsed without regeneration.
protocol.limitations: Separate local protocol, not an official leaderboard score. Training overlap with the full MMMU-Pro set has not been exhaustively excluded. No selection of models or prompts using these scores.
protocol.reuse: Original base and R20 raw generation outputs are reused. Only A, hard_answer and hard_reasoning require new inference.
protocol.interpretation: Supplementary comparison on already observed MMMU-Pro. This is separate from the independent-900 result, not another untouched holdout.

주의: 기존 Pro 출력은 보존했습니다. 전 모델에 같은 답 추출 규칙을 적용한 추가 비교입니다. 독립 900문항과 구분하며 전체 MMMU Test 점수로 표시하지 않습니다.
